name: Angelina Ishtar
original_name: アンジェリーナ・イシュター
source:
Class: Fertility Goddess
Skill: Goddess's Mischief

The goddess of fertility. She has the power to make any pregnant woman to deliver her child quickly and for children to grow fast. She allies with [url=/c4521]Kiryuu[/url] for the sake of making children. Has the power to grow and decrease in size.
translation:
